payload.summary: Added the global config ~/.specrun/config.json (accounts with token sources and limits), repo-side limits.accounts overrides, and the pure resolveAccounts that merges limits per MAD-3 with the implicit `default` account and MAD-17 warnings.
payload.commitMessage: feat(accounts): add global config, account limits and resolveAccounts
notes: src/config/globalConfig.ts: GLOBAL_CONFIG_FILE ('.specrun/config.json', relative to home), TokenSourceSchema / type TokenSource ({env} | {command}), GlobalConfigSchema / type GlobalConfig ({ accounts: { name; token?; limits? }[] }), loadGlobalConfig(deps: { homedir: () => string }): GlobalConfig — missing file → { accounts: [] }; bad JSON/schema → SpecrunError('config-invalid', '~/.specrun/config.json is invalid', details)

src/accounts/accounts.ts: IMPLICIT_ACCOUNT = 'default', type Account = { name; token: TokenSource | null; limits: AccountLimits }, interface ResolvedAccounts { accounts; warnings }, resolveAccounts(config: Config, global: GlobalConfig): ResolvedAccounts (pure, priority order kept)

src/config/configSchema.ts: exported AccountLimitsSchema (strict partial, 0–100), type AccountLimits = { sessionMinLeft: number; weeklyMinLeft: number }; Config['limits'] now also has accounts: Record<string, partial limits> (default {})
src/limits/policy.ts: decide() now takes limits: AccountLimits (was Config['limits']) — pass Account.limits directly
src/errors.ts: new SpecrunErrorCode values 'account-unknown' and 'account-token' (not used yet)
Warning text: `limits.accounts.<name>: no such account in ~/.specrun/config.json`, only emitted when the global config defines accounts
README: limits.accounts row in the Configuration table plus a '### Global config' section; CLAUDE.md layout lists accounts/

deviations.what: Changed the expected `limits` in the existing configSchema.spec.ts 'fills every default' case from { sessionMinLeft: 15, weeklyMinLeft: 5 } to also include accounts: {}.
deviations.why: The brief requires `limits.accounts` to default to {}, so the exact-equality assertion of the full parsed default config can't pass unchanged; the only change is the new default key.

deviations.what: Changed the parameter type of decide() in src/limits/policy.ts from Config['limits'] to AccountLimits.
deviations.why: Config['limits'] now requires `accounts`, which broke the existing policy.spec.ts literals at compile time. AccountLimits is the narrower type decide actually uses, so it is a type-only change and the existing tests stay as they are.

payload.summary: Added the pure chooseAccount/switchReason account policy on top of decide, optional `account` on the four session/usage/limit events, and the new account.switched event, with tests.
payload.commitMessage: feat(limits): add account choice policy and account events
notes: src/limits/policy.ts: exported types AccountUsage { name; limits: AccountLimits; snapshot: UsageSnapshot | null; blockedUntil: Date | null }, AccountChoice (go{account} | wait{account, until, reason: 'session-low'|'limit-hit'} | stop{reason:'weekly-low', resetsAt}), SwitchReason

chooseAccount(accounts, { burn, current }, now): AccountChoice — throws plain Error on empty list; candidate order = current (if in list) then list order; per account: weekly-low skip → blockedUntil > now wait limit-hit (until = blockedUntil as given, no margin added) → decide wait session-low → go
Without burn the first non-weekly-low candidate decides; with burn first go wins, else earliest until (ties to earlier candidate); all weekly-low → stop with earliest non-null weekly resetsAt
A weekly-low account is skipped even when it is also blocked (weekly checked first)
switchReason(from, now): 'limit-hit' if blocked, else 'weekly-low'/'session-low' by decide, else 'priority'
decide() unchanged (already took AccountLimits since MA-1)

src/events/eventSchema.ts: optional `account: string` on usage.snapshot, limit.wait, session.started, session.finished (missing = default); new AccountSwitchedSchema t:'account.switched' {task, from, to, reason} in EventSchema; exported ACCOUNT_SWITCH_REASONS
